charts.title: Technology roles are not interchangeable
constraints: Qualitative service roles are not accredited capacity values.
Do not add role classes into a technology score.

charts.title: Capacity and generation answer different questions
constraints: Capacity uses GW and generation uses TWh in separate panels.
Storage discharge is not primary generation.

charts.title: Lifecycle greenhouse-gas medians and ranges
constraints: Never publish medians without ranges or hide hydropower's upper tail.

charts.title: Technical, health, regulatory, and sustainability burdens
constraints: Unknown and configuration-specific evidence must remain visible.

charts.title: From hazard to attributable health outcome
constraints: No death inference from generation alone.
Separate routine, occupational, waste, and accident pathways.

charts.title: Nuclear evidence with official conflicts preserved
constraints: Show NRC and EIA reactor counts side by side with dates.
Capacity factor is not safety, cost, or project-delivery performance.

charts.title: Portfolio roles and missing compatible coefficients
constraints: Do not publish a one-number clean score.
Unavailable harmonized reliability, health, water, land, material, waste, and cost coefficients remain gaps.
